name: PostgreSQL
shortDescription: Web UI for managing several qBittorrent instances, with cross-seed, automations and backups, storing its data in a bundled PostgreSQL database.

alerts.message: The first visitor of a fresh instance creates the only account. Open the app and finish the setup right after deploying.
qui does not include qBittorrent. Add your existing qBittorrent instances in the UI; they must be reachable from this server with Web UI access enabled.
